confirmEmail.subject: Confirm your email for Screen Time
confirmEmail.body:
Hi,

Please confirm that this is your email address, so you can sign in to Screen Time:

{link}

The link works for 24 hours. If it has expired, sign in and ask for a new one.

If you didn't create a Screen Time account, you can ignore this email.
resetPassword.subject: Reset your Screen Time password
resetPassword.body:
Hi,

Someone asked to reset the password for the Screen Time account with this email address. To choose a new password, open this link:

{link}

The link works for 1 hour. If it has expired, ask for a new one on the sign-in page.

If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.
changeEmail.subject: Confirm your new email for Screen Time
changeEmail.body:
Hi,

You asked to use this address to sign in to Screen Time. To confirm it, open this link:

{link}

Until you do, your account keeps its current address. The link works for 24 hours.

If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.
emailChangeRequested.subject: Your Screen Time email is about to change
emailChangeRequested.body:
Hi,

Someone signed in to your Screen Time account asked to change its email address to {newEmail}. Nothing changes until the link sent to that address is opened.

If this wasn't you, someone else knows your password. Reset it now with this link, this will cancel the change:

{link}

The link works for 1 hour. If it has expired, choose "Forgot your password?" on the sign-in page.
registerAttempt.subject: You already have a Screen Time account
registerAttempt.body:
Hi,

Someone just tried to create a Screen Time account with this email address, but it already has one.

If that was you, sign in here:

{signInLink}

If you've forgotten your password, choose a new one here:

{forgotLink}

If it wasn't you, you can ignore this email. Nothing has changed on your account.
passwordChanged.subject: Your Screen Time password was changed
code.subject: Your Screen Time code
code.body:
Your Screen Time code is:

{code}

This code is only valid for 10 minutes.

If you didn't request a code, you can safely ignore this email.
twoFactorChanged.subject: Your Screen Time sign-in security changed
twoFactorChanged.appOn: An authenticator app was just turned on for your Screen Time account. Your sign-in codes now come from that app.
twoFactorChanged.appOff: The authenticator app was just turned off for your Screen Time account. Your sign-in codes are emailed to you again.
twoFactorChanged.recoveryCodes: New recovery codes were just made for your Screen Time account. The old ones no longer work.
